```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(crosstalk)
library(htmltools)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(reactable)
```

```{r load-data}
data_list_clean_paddocks <- targets::tar_read(data_list_clean_paddocks)

surveys <- purrr::imap(data_list_clean_paddocks, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x, data_type = .y)) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(paddock_id),
    !is.na(survey_date)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    survey_date = as.Date(survey_date),
    # coerce to character so ordered-factor levels from different survey types
    # don't prevent distinct() from collapsing identical rows
    season      = as.character(season),
    # standardised effort and result; definitions differ by data type:
    #   traps — effort: functional traps; result: mice per trap night
    #   rapid — effort: burrow transects surveyed; result: avg active burrows per transect
    effort = dplyr::case_when(
      data_type == "traps" ~ as.numeric(number_functional_traps),
      data_type == "rapid" ~ as.numeric(burrow_transects_surveyed),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    result = dplyr::case_when(
      data_type == "traps" & !is.na(number_functional_traps) & number_functional_traps > 0 ~
        round(as.numeric(number_mice_caught) / as.numeric(number_functional_traps), 3),
      data_type == "rapid" & !is.na(burrow_transects_surveyed) & burrow_transects_surveyed > 0 ~
        round(as.numeric(burrow_total_count) / as.numeric(burrow_transects_surveyed), 2),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # average percentage eaten across all individual chewcard_percent_N columns (rapid only)
    pct_chewcard = {
      m <- rowMeans(dplyr::pick(dplyr::starts_with("chewcard_percent_")), na.rm = TRUE)
      dplyr::if_else(data_type == "rapid" & !is.nan(m), round(m, 1), NA_real_)
    }
  ) |>
  # one row per unique paddock × date × season × data type × project;
  # raw count columns are included so the download can export them directly
  dplyr::distinct(paddock_id, longitude, latitude, state, ae_zone,
                  survey_date, season, year_adj, data_type, data_source,
                  effort, result, pct_chewcard,
                  number_functional_traps, number_mice_caught,
                  burrow_transects_surveyed, burrow_total_count,
                  chewcards_deployed, chewcards_detected) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_popup = paste0(
      "<b>Paddock ID:</b> ", paddock_id, "<br>",
      "<b>State:</b> ",      state,      "<br>",
      "<b>AEZ:</b> ",        ae_zone,    "<br>",
      "<b>Season:</b> ",     season, " ", year_adj, "<br>",
      "<b>Date:</b> ",       format(survey_date, "%d %b %Y"), "<br>",
      "<b>Data type:</b> ",  data_type,  "<br>",
      "<b>Project:</b> ",    data_source, "<br>",
      dplyr::case_when(
        data_type == "traps" ~ paste0(
          "<b>Functional traps:</b> ",       dplyr::if_else(is.na(effort), "—", as.character(effort)), "<br>",
          "<b>Mice / trap night:</b> ",       dplyr::if_else(is.na(result), "—", as.character(result))
        ),
        data_type == "rapid" ~ paste0(
          "<b>Burrow transects:</b> ",       dplyr::if_else(is.na(effort),       "—", as.character(effort)), "<br>",
          "<b>Avg burrows / transect:</b> ",  dplyr::if_else(is.na(result),       "—", as.character(result)), "<br>",
          "<b>Avg chew per card (%):</b> ",   dplyr::if_else(is.na(pct_chewcard), "—", paste0(pct_chewcard, "%"))
        ),
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ),
    # type-specific columns used in the summary table so NAs correctly exclude
    # the other data type from each column's aggregate
    effort_traps = dplyr::if_else(data_type == "traps", effort, NA_real_),
    result_traps = dplyr::if_else(data_type == "traps", result, NA_real_),
    effort_burrow = dplyr::if_else(data_type == "rapid", effort, NA_real_),
    result_burrow = dplyr::if_else(data_type == "rapid", result, NA_real_),
    # key must be unique for SharedData filtering to work correctly
    row_key = paste(paddock_id, survey_date, data_type, data_source,
                    round(longitude, 5), round(latitude, 5), sep = "_")
  ) |>
  # guard against any remaining duplicate keys
  dplyr::distinct(row_key, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r load-aez}
# Load AEZ polygons for the map overlay; ae_zone is already attached to survey
# points via the pipeline so no spatial join is needed here.
aez_adj <- targets::tar_read(aez_adj)

# Per-AEZ mouse detection: proportion of unique paddocks where mice were ever
# detected. Traps: any mice caught; rapid: any active burrows or chewcard activity.
mice_by_aez <- surveys |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mice_detected = dplyr::case_when(
      data_type == "traps" ~
        !is.na(number_mice_caught) & number_mice_caught > 0,
      data_type == "rapid" ~
        (!is.na(burrow_total_count) & burrow_total_count > 0) |
        (!is.na(chewcards_detected) & chewcards_detected > 0),
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(ae_zone, paddock_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(ever_detected = any(mice_detected), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(ae_zone) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_sites       = dplyr::n(),
    n_detected    = sum(ever_detected),
    pct_detected  = round(n_detected / n_sites * 100, 1),
    traffic_light = dplyr::case_when(
      pct_detected <= 33 ~ "Low",
      pct_detected <= 67 ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE               ~ "High"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Attribute join — sf geometry is preserved when sf object is on the left
aez_adj <- dplyr::left_join(aez_adj, mice_by_aez, by = "ae_zone")

# Also attach the AEZ-level detection stats to surveys so the summary table
# can display pct_detected alongside the per-survey result columns
surveys <- dplyr::left_join(
  surveys,
  dplyr::select(mice_by_aez, ae_zone, pct_detected, n_sites, n_detected, traffic_light),
  by = "ae_zone"
)
```

```{r colour-palette}
# Traffic light palette for AEZ polygon shading (proportion of sites with mice)
pal_aez <- colorFactor(
  palette  = c(Low = "#2ECC71", Moderate = "#F39C12", High = "#E74C3C"),
  levels   = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"),
  na.color = "#BDBDBD"
)

pal_type <- colorFactor(
  palette = brewer.pal(3, "Dark2")[seq_len(length(unique(surveys$data_type)))],
  domain  = surveys$data_type
)
```

```{r crosstalk-shared}
shared_surveys <- SharedData$new(surveys, key = ~row_key, group = "survey_data")
```

## Filters {.unnumbered}

Use the dropdowns to filter surveys. All active filters apply together (AND logic).

```{r filter-widgets}
bscols(
  widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
  filter_select("year_filter",    "Year",      shared_surveys, ~year_adj,    multiple = TRUE),
  filter_select("season_filter",  "Season",    shared_surveys, ~season,      multiple = TRUE),
  filter_select("type_filter",    "Data type", shared_surveys, ~data_type,   multiple = TRUE),
  filter_select("project_filter", "Project",   shared_surveys, ~data_source, multiple = TRUE)
)
```


```{r export-setup}
surveys_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  dplyr::select(surveys, paddock_id, ae_zone, state,
                longitude, latitude, survey_date, season, year_adj,
                data_type, data_source,
                number_functional_traps, number_mice_caught,
                burrow_transects_surveyed, burrow_total_count,
                chewcards_deployed, chewcards_detected,
                row_key),
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$script(paste0("var SURVEY_DATA = ", surveys_json, ";")),

  htmltools::tags$script('
    function downloadSurveyCSV() {
      var filterKeys = crosstalk.group("survey_data").var("filter").get();
      var keySet = filterKeys ? new Set(filterKeys) : null;

      var rows = keySet
        ? SURVEY_DATA.filter(function(r) { return keySet.has(r.row_key); })
        : SURVEY_DATA;

      if (rows.length === 0) { alert("No sites match the current selection."); return; }

      var cols = ["paddock_id","ae_zone","state",
                  "longitude","latitude","survey_date","season","year_adj",
                  "data_type","data_source",
                  "number_functional_traps","number_mice_caught",
                  "burrow_transects_surveyed","burrow_total_count",
                  "chewcards_deployed","chewcards_detected"];

      var csv = cols.join(",") + "\\n" +
        rows.map(function(r) {
          return cols.map(function(c) {
            var v = (r[c] === null || r[c] === undefined) ? "" : r[c];
            return \'"\' + String(v).replace(/"/g, \'""\')+\'"\';
          }).join(",");
        }).join("\\n");

      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], {type:"text/csv"}));
      a.download = "survey_sites.csv";
      a.click();
    }
  '),

  htmltools::tags$button(
    "Download selected sites (CSV)",
    onclick = "downloadSurveyCSV()",
    class   = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm",
    style   = "margin-top: 8px;"
  ),

  # Recalculates per-AEZ mouse detection proportion from the currently-filtered
  # rows and updates polygon fill colours to match the traffic light thresholds.
  # Uses crosstalk.FilterHandle to listen for filter changes; on each change it
  # rebuilds the per-AEZ paddock/detection counts from SURVEY_DATA (already
  # loaded above) restricted to the active row_key set, then calls
  # layer.setStyle() on each polygon layer identified by its layerId option.
  htmltools::tags$script('
    HTMLWidgets.addPostRenderHandler(function() {

      var TRAFFIC_COLORS = {
        Low:    "#2ECC71",
        Mod:    "#F39C12",
        High:   "#E74C3C",
        nodata: "#BDBDBD"
      };

      // Map detection percentage to the traffic light colour bucket.
      function trafficColor(pct) {
        if (pct === null || isNaN(pct)) return TRAFFIC_COLORS.nodata;
        if (pct <= 33) return TRAFFIC_COLORS.Low;
        if (pct <= 67) return TRAFFIC_COLORS.Mod;
        return TRAFFIC_COLORS.High;
      }

      // Build an ae_zone -> fillColor map from an array of survey rows.
      // Mirrors the R detection logic: traps = any mice caught;
      // rapid = any active burrows OR any chewcard activity.
      function computeColors(rows) {
        var paddocks = {}, detected = {};
        rows.forEach(function(r) {
          var z = r.ae_zone;
          if (!z) return;
          if (!paddocks[z]) { paddocks[z] = {}; detected[z] = {}; }
          paddocks[z][r.paddock_id] = true;
          var hit = r.data_type === "traps"
            ? (r.number_mice_caught !== null && r.number_mice_caught > 0)
            : r.data_type === "rapid"
              ? ((r.burrow_total_count !== null && r.burrow_total_count > 0) ||
                 (r.chewcards_detected !== null && r.chewcards_detected > 0))
              : false;
          if (hit) detected[z][r.paddock_id] = true;
        });
        var colors = {};
        Object.keys(paddocks).forEach(function(z) {
          var n = Object.keys(paddocks[z]).length;
          var d = Object.keys(detected[z]).length;
          colors[z] = trafficColor(n > 0 ? (d / n * 100) : null);
        });
        return colors;
      }

      // Walk all leaflet layers; update fillColor on polygon layers whose
      // layerId matches an AEZ name (polygons have _latlngs, circles do not).
      function applyColors(colorMap) {
        var widgets = document.querySelectorAll(".leaflet");
        var map = null;
        for (var i = 0; i < widgets.length; i++) {
          var w = HTMLWidgets.find(widgets[i]);
          if (w && w.getMap) { map = w.getMap(); break; }
        }
        if (!map) return;
        map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
          if (layer._latlngs && layer.options && layer.options.layerId) {
            var color = colorMap.hasOwnProperty(layer.options.layerId)
              ? colorMap[layer.options.layerId]
              : TRAFFIC_COLORS.nodata;
            layer.setStyle({ fillColor: color });
          }
        });
      }

      // Initialise colours from the full unfiltered dataset.
      applyColors(computeColors(SURVEY_DATA));

      // Re-colour whenever any crosstalk filter changes.
      var fh = new crosstalk.FilterHandle("survey_data");
      fh.on("change", function(e) {
        var keys = e.value;
        var rows = keys
          ? (function() {
              var s = new Set(keys);
              return SURVEY_DATA.filter(function(r) { return s.has(r.row_key); });
            })()
          : SURVEY_DATA;
        applyColors(computeColors(rows));
      });

    });
  ')
)
```

## Map {.unnumbered}

```{r map}
leaflet(width = "100%", height = "700px") |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron",     group = "Light (default)") |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery",    group = "Satellite") |>
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap.Mapnik", group = "OpenStreetMap") |>

  addPolygons(
    data        = aez_adj,
    group       = "AEZ zones",
    layerId     = ~ae_zone,
    fillColor   = ~pal_aez(traffic_light),
    fillOpacity = 0.4,
    color       = "white",
    weight      = 1.2,
    label       = ~ae_zone,
    popup       = ~paste0(
      "<b>AEZ:</b> ", ae_zone, "<br>",
      "<b>Mouse presence:</b> ",
      ifelse(is.na(traffic_light), "No data", traffic_light), "<br>",
      "<b>Sites detected:</b> ",
      ifelse(is.na(pct_detected), "—",
             paste0(n_detected, " / ", n_sites, " (", pct_detected, "%)"))
    ),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2.5, fillOpacity = 0.6, bringToFront = FALSE
    )
  ) |>

  addCircleMarkers(
    data        = shared_surveys,
    lng         = ~longitude,
    lat         = ~latitude,
    group       = "Survey sites",
    radius      = 6,
    color       = ~pal_type(data_type),
    fillColor   = ~pal_type(data_type),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    stroke      = TRUE,
    weight      = 1,
    opacity     = 1,
    popup       = ~label_popup,
    label       = ~data_type
  ) |>

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal      = pal_type,
    values   = surveys$data_type,
    title    = "Data type",
    opacity  = 0.85
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal      = pal_aez,
    values   = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"),
    title    = "Mouse presence<br><small>% of sites with detection</small>",
    opacity  = 0.85
  ) |>

  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups    = c("Light (default)", "Satellite", "OpenStreetMap"),
    overlayGroups = c("AEZ zones", "Survey sites"),
    options       = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>

  addScaleBar(position = "topright", options = scaleBarOptions(imperial = FALSE))
```

## Survey summary per AEZ {.unnumbered}

Updates with the filters above. Result columns are specific to each data type: traps (mice per trap night) and rapid assessment (avg active burrows per transect; avg % eaten per chewcard).

```{r summary-table}
max_aez <- surveys |> dplyr::group_by(ae_zone) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(paddock_id), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::pull(n) |> max()
max_result_traps <- max(surveys$result_traps, na.rm = TRUE)
max_result_burrow <- max(surveys$result_burrow, na.rm = TRUE)
max_pct_chewcard <- max(surveys$pct_chewcard, na.rm = TRUE)

# hide detail columns not needed in the grouped view
hidden_cols <- list(
  longitude                 = colDef(show = FALSE),
  latitude                  = colDef(show = FALSE),
  state                     = colDef(show = FALSE),
  survey_date               = colDef(show = FALSE),
  season                    = colDef(show = FALSE),
  year_adj                  = colDef(show = FALSE),
  data_type                 = colDef(show = FALSE),
  data_source               = colDef(show = FALSE),
  effort                    = colDef(show = FALSE),
  result                    = colDef(show = FALSE),
  effort_traps              = colDef(show = FALSE),
  effort_burrow             = colDef(show = FALSE),
  # raw count columns kept for the download but not shown in the table
  number_functional_traps   = colDef(show = FALSE),
  number_mice_caught        = colDef(show = FALSE),
  burrow_transects_surveyed = colDef(show = FALSE),
  burrow_total_count        = colDef(show = FALSE),
  chewcards_deployed        = colDef(show = FALSE),
  chewcards_detected        = colDef(show = FALSE),
  # AEZ-level detection stats — pct_detected is shown explicitly; others hidden
  traffic_light             = colDef(show = FALSE),
  n_sites                   = colDef(show = FALSE),
  n_detected                = colDef(show = FALSE),
  label_popup               = colDef(show = FALSE),
  row_key                   = colDef(show = FALSE)
)

# unique paddock count with blue heat-map intensity
count_col <- function(max_val) {
  colDef(
    name      = "Paddocks",
    minWidth  = 110,
    aggregate = JS("function(values) { return new Set(values).size; }"),
    style     = JS(sprintf("
      function(rowInfo) {
        var val = rowInfo.aggregated ? parseFloat(rowInfo.value) : rowInfo.row['paddock_id'];
        if (!val || isNaN(val)) return {};
        var intensity = Math.min(val / %d, 1);
        var lightness  = Math.round(95 - intensity * 50);
        return { background: 'hsl(210, 70%%, ' + lightness + '%%)', fontWeight: rowInfo.aggregated ? 'bold' : 'normal' };
      }
    ", max_val))
  )
}

# mean of non-NA values with blue heat-map intensity; max_val scales the colour range
heat_col <- function(label, max_val, min_width = 100) {
  colDef(
    name      = label,
    minWidth  = min_width,
    aggregate = JS("
      function(values) {
        var nums = values.filter(function(v) { return v !== null && !isNaN(v); });
        if (nums.length === 0) return '—';
        return (nums.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b; }) / nums.length).toFixed(2);
      }
    "),
    style = JS(sprintf("
      function(rowInfo) {
        var val = parseFloat(rowInfo.value);
        if (isNaN(val) || val <= 0) return {};
        var intensity = Math.min(val / %s, 1);
        var lightness  = Math.round(95 - intensity * 50);
        return { background: 'hsl(210, 70%%, ' + lightness + '%%)', fontWeight: rowInfo.aggregated ? 'bold' : 'normal' };
      }
    ", max_val))
  )
}

htmltools::tags$style("
  #aez-table .rt-expander-button, #aez-table .rt-td-expandable { padding-left: 8px; }
  #aez-table .rt-expander-button { display: none; }
")

reactable(
  shared_surveys,
  elementId    = "aez-table",
  groupBy      = "ae_zone",
  columns      = c(list(
    ae_zone      = colDef(name = "AEZ", minWidth = 200,
                          grouped = JS("function(cellInfo) { return cellInfo.value; }")),
    paddock_id   = count_col(max_aez),
    # pct_detected is constant within each AEZ group; aggregate returns the first value
    pct_detected = colDef(
      name      = "Sites detected (%)",
      minWidth  = 140,
      format    = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 1),
      aggregate = JS("
        function(values) {
          var nums = values.filter(function(v) { return v !== null && !isNaN(v); });
          return nums.length > 0 ? nums[0].toFixed(1) + '%' : '—';
        }
      "),
      style = JS("
        function(rowInfo) {
          var val = parseFloat(rowInfo.value);
          if (isNaN(val)) return rowInfo.aggregated ? { fontWeight: 'bold' } : {};
          var bg = val <= 33 ? '#2ECC71' : val <= 67 ? '#F39C12' : '#E74C3C';
          return { background: bg, fontWeight: rowInfo.aggregated ? 'bold' : 'normal' };
        }
      ")
    ),
    result_traps = heat_col("Mice / trap night",  max_result_traps),
    result_burrow = heat_col("Burrows / transect", max_result_burrow),
    pct_chewcard = heat_col("Avg chew / card",    max_pct_chewcard)
  ), hidden_cols),
  columnGroups = list(
    colGroup(name = "Mouse presence",   columns = "pct_detected"),
    colGroup(name = "Traps",            columns = "result_traps"),
    colGroup(name = "Rapid assessment", columns = c("result_burrow", "pct_chewcard"))
  ),
  defaultSorted   = list(ae_zone = "asc"),
  defaultExpanded = FALSE,
  pagination = FALSE, bordered = TRUE, striped = FALSE, highlight = TRUE
)
```
